items.title: The Options Market Says Dell Stock Can Halve Or Double
items.summary: Dell Technologies (DELL) stock trades at about $588, and the options market has already priced where it is most likely to sit twelve months from now: there is a two-in-three chance it lands between roughly $290 and roughly $1,180. That band is what a holder is carrying, in dollars. It prices the size of the move and says nothing about the direction. The size is the part worth your attention.

items.title: What Needs To Be True To Buy Rigetti Stock Today?
items.summary: Rigetti Computing (RGTI) sells quantum computing systems into a market its own management calls early, which makes the buy question hard to answer. You cannot lean on earnings, because Rigetti loses money, which leaves its price-to-earnings ratio meaningless. You can measure what you pay for each dollar of sales. Here is that walk, one step at a time.

items.title: IBM (IBM) Lands $1 Billion Quantum Foundry Award And Deepens AI Oversight
items.summary: International Business Machines (NYSE: IBM) said its subsidiary Anderon won a US$1b federal award to build a U.S. quantum chip foundry, alongside a further US$1b IBM commitment to the project. The planned facility is described as the first stand-alone quantum wafer foundry in the U.S., focused on quantum chip manufacturing under CHIPS Act funding.
